units: <cite ref="Shabbat 8b:7">Sabb. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>דעבידי אינשי לקָרוּרֵי נפשייהו</he> when people are wont to cool themselves (by walking in pools), v. <cite ref="T01052"><he>רָקָק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 76a:5">Pes. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>אַקּוּרי קא מֵיקַר ליה</he> it cools the juice off; a. e.

senses.gloss: , Ithpol. אִתְקוֹרָר to be cooled off, cool one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 2:5">Targ. Y. Ex. II, 5</cite> <he>לאִתְקַרְרָא</he>.
